#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Independently synthesised from the requirement + public API surface.

Not copied from an author test. Not derived from a diff.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import sys

from receipt_gate import validate_receipt

CASES = [{'id': 'missing-source-probe', 'input': {'verdict': 'CONFIRMED', 'verifier_probe': 'verifier-alpha'}, 'expect_ok': False, 'expect_reason': 'empty-source-probe'}, {'id': 'empty-source-probe', 'input': {'verdict': 'CONFIRMED', 'source_probe': '', 'verifier_probe': 'verifier-alpha'}, 'expect_ok': False, 'expect_reason': 'empty-source-probe'}]


def main() -> int:
    failed = 0
    for case in CASES:
        got = validate_receipt(case["input"])
        ok = got.get("ok") is case["expect_ok"] and got.get("reason") == case["expect_reason"]
        print(
            "CASE {id} got={got!r} expect_ok={expect_ok} "
            "expect_reason={expect_reason} pass={ok}".format(
                id=case["id"],
                got=got,
                expect_ok=case["expect_ok"],
                expect_reason=case["expect_reason"],
                ok=ok,
            )
        )
        if not ok:
            failed += 1
    print("SUMMARY failed={0} of {1}".format(failed, len(CASES)))
    return 1 if failed else 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())
